## Instagram Carousel v2.6

Creates up to four carousel slides from one Instagram photo (and an optional FACE close-up): same scene, camera, outfit and person, a new pose per slide written as text. Qwen Image 2.1 edit, no ControlNet.

### custom nodes
- [MATRIX-LAB-Nodes](https://github.com/JsonMatrixLab/MATRIX-LAB-Nodes): resolution and clean PNG save
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy): Power Lora Loader and ON/OFF controls

### models
- diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors
- text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors
- vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
- loras/bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors and loras/p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors (both OFF)

### inputs
- PHOTO = `<image1>`: the Instagram photo of your character the carousel is made from. Any size; it is fitted (center crop) to the size node.
- FACE = `<image2>` (optional): a clear face close-up of the same person; it keeps the facial details stable. Any size; scaled to about 1 MP. No close-up? Press FACE OFF: the slides then keep the face of the PHOTO.

### poses
Each slide has a POSE field: describe only the body pose, without a subject, for example "one hand resting on the hip". Optional: add an expression at the end ("..., laughing"). Keep the pose possible in the photo's scene (standing to standing, sitting to sitting) and name sides by the image edges ("the hand on the left side of the image"). The prompt puts the pose where it says [POSE].

### size and switches
MATRIX QWEN IMAGE 2.1 RESOLUTION sets the size of every slide (default 3:4; a carousel keeps one aspect). FACE ON/OFF switches the face close-up and its prompt together. Left of each slide: SLIDE n ON/OFF, POSE, SEED (change it to re-roll only that slide) and STEPS (default 25). ALL SLIDES switches every slide. Each slide saves a metadata PNG (reloads the workflow) and a clean PNG (no metadata: post this one).

## Prompting with Qwen Image 2.1 tags

The encoder of every slide receives the images in this order:
- `<image1>` = PHOTO (the image that is edited; its size is the output size).
- `<image2>` = FACE (optional; only keeps the facial details of the same person).

Name both with their roles and keep the person of `<image1>` as the subject; a prompt that starts with `<image2>` turns the face close-up into the subject.

### PROMPT · FACE ON ([POSE] is replaced per slide)
```text
<image1> is the photo to edit. Keep its scene, background, camera
angle, framing, lighting, outfit and hair exactly as they are. Change
only the body pose of the person in <image1>: [POSE]. <image2> is a
close-up of the same person: use it only to keep the facial features
accurate and consistent (face shape, eyes, nose, lips, skin and
freckles), and take nothing else from <image2> (no background,
clothing, hairstyle, lighting, crop or zoom). Frozen still moment, no
motion blur, no double exposure.
```

### PROMPT · FACE OFF (used when FACE is off; no `<image2>`)
```text
<image1> is the photo to edit. Keep its scene, background, camera
angle, framing, lighting, outfit, hair and the person's face exactly
as they are. Change only the body pose of the person in <image1>:
[POSE]. Frozen still moment, no motion blur, no double exposure.
```

Use only AI-generated characters or images you have the rights and consent for.
